label: relies on mechanism
type: the subject capability/procedure depends on the object concept as its underlying implementation. Distinct from dependsOnService (a service-to-service architectural dependency) - this is a feature depending on a specific, named mechanism, not a service.
evidence: Users can update/recreate/rebuild the indexes without interfering with the live systems by leveraging the index-alias feature.
This may be particularly useful when an index needs to be updated: to avoid downtime, while the current index remains in service, a clone of the current index can be created, modified, and tested.
note: Both occurrences have the same subject, zero-downtime index upgrades, and two different object mechanisms (search:index-aliases, fts:clone-index) it composes - stated on two sibling pages (the HA overview and its zero-downtime-upgrades sub-page) independently.
relates_to_competency_question: What underlying mechanism does a higher-level capability (like zero-downtime index upgrades) actually depend on?
